title: Knowledge base
description: Fenix learns your apps, context, and business logic so it does not flag your own design decisions as vulnerabilities. This is the technical catalog it checks every finding against: the family, the risk, the vulnerable code and the fixed one.
searchPlaceholder: Title, CWE, risk summary or OWASP category

states.emptyDescription: Run migration f1a2b3c4d5e6 to seed the initial notes.
states.error: The catalog could not be loaded

documents.deleteBody: The document "{{title}}" will be deleted and will stop being part of the assistant's context. This cannot be undone.
documents.loadFailed: The workspace documents could not be loaded.
documents.savedToast: Document saved. The assistant will use it as context.
documents.emptyTitle: No business rules or documentation indexed yet
documents.emptyBody: Add documents in OKF format so scans and the assistant stop producing false positives.

okfEditor.preview: See the OKF document that will be sent
okfEditor.valid: The frontmatter is valid. It can be saved now.
okfEditor.saveFailed: The document could not be saved. Check the content and try again.

okf.missingFrontmatter: The frontmatter block is missing. The document must start with a line of three dashes.
okf.unclosedFrontmatter: The frontmatter is not closed: the closing line of three dashes is missing.
okf.missingType: `type` is missing from the frontmatter. Without it the document cannot be retrieved by type.
okf.invalidType: `type` is not a value of the format. Allowed: concept, business_rule, api_spec, architecture.
okf.missingDescription: `description` is missing from the frontmatter. It is what gets injected when the document is cited without its body.
